claude.sample_unit: vignette-factor combinations (60 clinician-authored vignettes x 16 variations)

links.outcome: Emergency-case accuracy and under-triage with versus without UMLS-CUI augmentation
links.effect: CUI augmentation decreased under-triage but increased over-triage in both models. Emergency-case accuracy rose from 73.0% to 80.7% (GPT-4o-mini) and from 60.5% to 68.5% (MedGemma 27B).
links.quote: Emergency-case accuracy improved from 73.0% to 80.7% for GPT-4o-mini and from 60.5% to 68.5% for MedGemma 27B.

links.outcome: Baseline LLM recognition of emergency cases in triage vignettes
links.effect: Baseline emergency-case accuracy was 73.0% for GPT-4o-mini and 60.5% for MedGemma 27B, indicating missed emergencies.
links.quote: Emergency-case accuracy improved from 73.0% to 80.7% for GPT-4o-mini and from 60.5% to 68.5% for MedGemma 27B.

links.outcome: Sensitivity of triage output to anchoring statements with and without CUI augmentation
links.effect: CUI augmentation reduced susceptibility to anchoring statements (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: CUI augmentation also reduced susceptibility to anchoring statements.
